description: Source file for menu handling and configuration option management in a Linux kernel or similar embedded system project. Contains functions for creating, modifying, validating, and finalizing menu structures, as well as managing properties, dependencies, and visual aspects of configuration options.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: Represents a menu or a configuration option node in the menu tree.

classes.name: property
classes.description: Represents properties attached to menu or symbol entries, such as prompts, defaults, and visibility conditions.

classes.name: expr
classes.description: Represents logical expressions used for dependencies and conditions.

classes.name: symbol
classes.description: Represents a configuration symbol, such as a toggle, prompt, or choice.

classes.name: file
classes.description: Represents a source file location with name and line number information.

methods.name: void menu_warn(struct menu * menu,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Logs a warning related to a menu item.

methods.name: void prop_warn(struct property * prop,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Logs a warning related to a property.

methods.name: void menu_add_entry(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Adds a new menu entry and links it into the menu tree.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_add_menu(void)
methods.description: Creates and adds a submenu node under the current menu.

methods.name: void menu_end_menu(void)
methods.description: Ends the current menu context and returns to the parent menu.

methods.name: void menu_add_dep(struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_set_type(int type)
methods.description: Sets the type of the current menu symbol, with validation and warnings.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prop(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prompt(enum prop_type type,char * prompt,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a prompt property to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_visibility(struct expr * expr)
methods.description: Adds a visibility expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_expr(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a generic expression property.

methods.name: void menu_add_symbol(enum prop_type type,struct symbol * sym,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a symbol reference property.

methods.name: void menu_finalize(struct menu * parent)
methods.description: Recursively processes and validates a menu subtree, propagating dependencies and types.

methods.name: bool menu_has_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns whether a menu has an associated prompt.

methods.name: bool menu_is_empty(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks if a menu is empty or only contains invisible entries.

methods.name: bool menu_is_visible(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Determines if a menu item is visible based on its properties and dependencies.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the prompt text for a menu.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_get_parent_menu(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu.

methods.name: bool menu_has_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks if a menu has help text.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_help(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the help text for a menu.

methods.name: void menu_get_ext_help(struct menu * menu,struct gstr * help)
methods.description: Generates a detailed help string including dependencies, location, and prompt.

methods.name: struct:gstr get_relations_str(struct symbol ** sym_arr,struct list_head * head)
methods.description: Creates a string describing relationships among symbols based on the menu's data.
